mission.title: Timetable
mission.description: Hand the General's commandos over to the Trainman, then tell the General himself it is time to leave the Matrix.

npc.say: No... No, it won't take long...

phase.briefing:
The General has kindly given us the program necessary to transfer his soldiers between the Matrix and your...whatever you call it. I don't care for calling it "The Real," operative--awfully pretentious, you know. I think it would be more accurate if I called it "The Sludge-Pit," for instance.
But I know you have no head for philosophical discussion, so I'll skip ahead to the part you're paid to play. The Trainman will be transporting the General and his troops out of the Matrix. The Machines are still hot on the General's heels, so time is of the essence. You will be collecting a few of his commandos, and handing them off to the Trainman.

enter.say: Got a couple programs on my screen; those should be the commandos we're looking for.

talk.say: I wish we could stay with you and stick it to those Machines, sir.

objective.text: Lead the commandos out of the area

phase.briefing:
Take them to the Trainman, operative, and call me back once you've dropped them off.
Oh, and those two may be attracting a certain amount of Machine attention, so try to keep your eyes open, hm?

enter.say: So far, so good. That's where the Trainman's supposed to be. Looks like we've got some friendlies patrolling the area.

objective.text: Lead the commandos to the Trainman

done.say: So he's all squared away, then?

talk.say: Yes, yes, I'll handle them. Now, get out of here before you bring the Machines down on me!

done.say: Yeah, I guess he's just peachy.

complete.say: I hope he knows what he's doing.
Thank you, sir. Maybe I'll see you on the other side.

phase.briefing:
We've just about got all the General's men out of the way, and it's time for the rustbucket himself to take the plunge. We're trying to keep the Machines from getting wind of this, so you'll be giving him the word in person.
And eh...try to hurry him along, would you? The Machines are getting themselves worked up into something of a lather over this.

enter.say: He should be in there. I hope that aerodynamic suit means he can run fast...

talk.say:
Yes, of course. I need to be there in any case to make sure that he has the transfer program configured correctly.
The Machines are closing in... Soldier, I want you to take this commando here and proceed to the Trainman ahead of me. Maybe you can draw some of them off.

done.say: Oh, that's great... This better be the last time we have to take orders from that yahoo...

objective.text: Lead the commando out of the area

phase.briefing: We're pressed for time, so just get going. I really don't care what you do with that commando of yours. I want you to meet the General at the Trainman's location, and make sure he's following the program.

enter.say:
I'm reading hostile programs in there, {player}! Looks like the Machines caught up with the General.
Serves him right for trying to use you as a decoy...

done.say: You're clear. Better go check on the Trainman and the General.

talk.say: What is this? He's refusing to leave! Is he out of his mind?

done.say: What? What does he think he's doing? Can you talk some sense into him?
They'll kill him--kill him! And the rest of us! The madman's going to get us all killed!

talk.say: I'm sorry, soldier. I've seen as many of my men out as I could save, but now I have some unfinished business to take care of.

done.say: Flood was right...he really is trying to get himself deleted.

mission.finish:
By Hell and Hades! That fool is jeopardizing our plan!
All he has to do is catch a train, and he can't even get that right...
I don't care what his issue is; one way or another, he is going to get on that train.
